changelog:
Initial release of agent-browser-core skill for structured web automation.

- Provides production-ready playbooks for agent-browser CLI, supporting deterministic AI-driven automation.
- Supports compact snapshots, refs, and structured JSON command output.
- Includes operational guardrails with clear safety and security defaults.
- Features Node.js fallback for broader compatibility.
- Documentation covers install, commands, workflow patterns, safety, and troubleshooting.
summary: OpenClaw skill for the agent-browser CLI (Rust-based with Node.js fallback) enabling AI-friendly web automation with snapshots, refs, and structured commands.
